definitions.correction_support: same phase pooled-box noise-free2/50 available command trajectories clean issued correction (f,l,yaw effort), scale(.1,.1,.05); nearest distance > leave-one-episode-out p99 radius. definitions.correction: norm of clean teacher issued wheel pulse integrals, inverse wheel_mix / .1s; command magnitude, not measured motion
definitions.causality: support novelty and reacquisition describe noisy trajectories; no matched noise-off runs, so noise causation is unmeasured
definitions.relay: deterministic fixed v7 command relay replay; not wheel rotation/physics counterfactual
definitions.contact_limit: saved evaluation records target finger forces only; no base/roller/non-target contact pairs or wheel angle/velocity; physical obstruction cannot be excluded
